This '''Twi'lek pirate''' was a part of a contingent of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] hired by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] as security for a secret base in the [[Valsedian asteroid belt]]. The group came under attack by [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].
